/.title: Independent Bookstore Since 1973
/.description: Camarillo Bookworm - your neighborhood independent bookstore in Camarillo, CA since 1973. New releases, staff picks, author events, and book clubs.

/shop.title: Shop Books
/shop.description: Browse new releases, bestsellers, kids' books, and more at Camarillo Bookworm, Ventura County's independent bookstore. See what's on our shelves today.

/events.title: Author Events & Book Clubs
/events.description: Author readings, signings, book clubs, and kids' story times at Camarillo Bookworm, 93 E Daily Dr, Camarillo, CA. See the calendar and RSVP.

/staff-picks.title: Staff Picks
/staff-picks.description: Books our Camarillo Bookworm booksellers love and hand-sell - honest recommendations from people who read for a living.

/gift-cards.title: Gift Cards
/gift-cards.description: Give the gift of reading with a Camarillo Bookworm gift card - good for any book in our Camarillo, CA store.

/about.title: About Us
/about.description: The Bookworm is Camarillo's independent, woman-owned bookstore, a cornerstone of the community since 1973. Our story, what you'll find here, hours and directions.

/read-alikes.title: Read-Alikes
/read-alikes.description: Loved a book and want more like it? Find what to read next with read-alike recommendations from Camarillo Bookworm.

/collections.title: Collections
/collections.description: Curated book lists from Camarillo Bookworm: award winners, banned books, book club picks, California writers, page-to-screen, and more.

/collections/awards.title: Award Winners
/collections/awards.description: Pulitzer, National Book Award, Booker, Hugo, Newbery, Caldecott winners and more - every year's winners and finalists, at Camarillo Bookworm.

/contact.title: Contact & Hours
/contact.description: Visit Camarillo Bookworm at 93 E Daily Dr, Camarillo, CA 93010. Open Mon-Fri 10-6, Sat 10-5, Sun 12-5. Call (805) 482-1384.

/newsletter.title: Newsletter
/newsletter.description: Be first to hear about author events, signings and book clubs at Camarillo Bookworm, plus the week's new books - one short email from your neighborhood bookstore.
